svg.title: Location-less errors and build/check-mode support
svg.desc: Retained errors without source locations now reach diagnostic listeners; new build/test wiring is explicit. Constructor errors keep their old suppression timing; later location-less errors can be suppressed by tidy policy. GN lists the new source. The lit test verifies tidy timing works even when ordinary tidy checking is disabled.
svg.text: Retained errors without source locations now reach diagnostic listeners; new build/test wiring is explicit.
// Handle diagnostics coming from command-line arguments. The source manager
// is *not* available at this point, so we cannot use it.
return; // non-errors add too much noise, do not show them.
// Put it at the start of the main file, for a lack of a better place.

/// modify the final diagnostic, or store some information to surface code
// Handle diagnostics coming from command-line arguments. The source manager
// is *not* available at this point, so we cannot use it.
return; // non-errors add too much noise, do not show them.
// Put it at the start of the main file, for a lack of a better place.
/// Called everytime a diagnostic is encountered. Modules can use this
/// modify the final diagnostic, or store some information to surface code
/// Retained errors without source locations are also reported, with an
/// empty File and a zero-length Range at (0, 0).
// Time only baseline builds to avoid timing-stability retries.
// CHECK: Timing AST build with individual clang-tidy checks
Constructor errors keep their old suppression timing; later location-less errors can be suppressed by tidy policy.
GN lists the new source. The lit test verifies tidy timing works even when ordinary tidy checking is disabled.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
